decision_timing: after alpha confirmation and before the first new r-controlled physical call
observed_information: alpha_star=10 and alpha_2=1 were fixed by the sealed same-state two-metric confirmation; no r value other than the pre-existing r=0.5 trajectory has been observed at alpha=10
preserved_rules: the frozen Chignolin IR-IVM numerical algorithm
one BB task per host, jobs=1, all thread caps equal one
immutable member registration and execution authorization
actual optimization Number of Forces with fixed endpoints contributing zero
only fully reparameterization-committed states are eligible
same-state discrete unnormalized I_perp and arc-length-500 Delta E
no offline diagnostic feedback within an optimization trajectory

r_controlled_scan.selection: freeze all five results first; evaluate every eligible committed path under the common metric protocol; choose r_star and r_2 by the existing joint-score order while reporting raw metrics and Pareto relations
r_controlled_scan.budget_extension: run an independent 990-N_F confirmation only if a leading member has no eligible committed path at 480, the leading same-state joint quantities differ by at most 10 percent, or the leading candidates are Pareto-incomparable

m_max_controlled_scan.exact_early_stop: if every frozen proximal subproblem for m_max=k terminates before the inner-step cap by its residual condition, all larger m_max values are deterministic exact aliases until another control changes; record an alias receipt and do not claim unexecuted aliases as measurements

local_interaction.design: complete 2^3 local factorial over alpha_star/alpha_2, r_star/r_2, and two behaviorally distinct m_max values

long_budget.first_stage: select two representatives from the full controlled-scan/local-interaction Pareto set and run each once at 4080 N_F on the same reference host
long_budget.final_stage: run the 4080 winner at 9990 N_F; extend the runner-up only if its joint quantity differs by at most 10 percent or the two are Pareto-incomparable
long_budget.prefix_rule: the longer trajectory must reproduce every fully closed shorter-budget state, excluding wall time and a quarantined terminal partial tail
